title: Pretty yellow and white
text: Pretty yellow and white. Very nice, hard to find buffalo plaid with true white. Great when stuffed with a down pillow. Only 4 stars because they’ve stitched a label on the exterior of the pillow cover. Don’t want to cut it off as it may affect the integrity of the seam.

product_metadata.title: Phantoscope Pack of 2 Buffalo Check Plaid Throw Pillow Covers Outdoor Indoor Throw Pillows Farmhouse Square Pillow Cases for Home Decor Grey,20 x 20 Inches
features: 【Premium Quality】- Phantoscope pillow covers are made of top grade polyester and cotton blend, comfortable without odors or allergens retardants, no pilling and no stimulation to the skin, friendly for kids and pets.
【Hidden Zipper】 - The throw pillow covers feature invisible zipper closure, that makes it easy to insert and replace and meanwhile keeps an elegant look.

【Package includes】- The cushion case measures 20x20 inch/50x50cm. Package contains 2 pieces of throw pillow cases. INSERT ARE NOT INCLUDED; In order to present the best shape, a bigger size pillow insert is recommended.

【Plaid Design】- The classic double-sided buffalo check rectangular pattern cushion covers make a vintage style decoration for your home. Multiple size and color selections are available for all your home needs, brillant for your home decor!
【Wash and Cares】- Our throw pillowcases are fade resistant and stain resistant, machine wash in cold water, separately from other articles, delicate cycle, tumble dry low.
